summary: Backend regression + new-feature tests for period filter (granularity=all|monthly|quarterly, period=YYYY-MM|YYYY-Qn) with previous-period comparison and deltas on /api/reports. Added 10 new tests to TestReportsPeriodFilter covering: granularity=all returns 'Semua Periode' with no previous, monthly 2026-08 returns 'Agu 2026' / prev 'Jul 2026' with full previous{} + deltas{}, quarterly 2026-Q3 returns 'Q3 2026'/'Q2 2026', year rollback for Q1->Q4 previous year and January->December previous year, year rollforward for December (period='Des 2026', valid end range), 422 for granularity='weekly' and 422 for monthly without period, Shopee+monthly filter returns correct label with empty channel_summary and operating_expense=0, and POST /purchases + POST /production created_at persistence verified via cash.out delta in current-month report. All 23/23 backend tests pass (100%).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py _period_range: month rollover uses (m//12) and (m%12)+1 which correctly produces Jan next year for m=12, but this compact arithmetic is easy to break; add a unit-level docstring example.

operating_expense stays hardcoded at 3,840,000 (monthly value) even for quarterly ('Q3 2026') and 'all-time' aggregations — quarterly should arguably be ~3x, 'all' should sum historical OpEx; currently the same flat number is added regardless of period length which distorts net_profit and net_profit_pct deltas.
_pct edge case: when previous==0 and current==0 returns None, but frontend must handle None separately from a numeric 0.0 delta — document contract or return 0.0 for consistency.

Legacy production/purchases rows created before this iteration have no created_at field and are silently excluded from any granularity!='all' report. If those rows should be preserved for history, a migration is needed to backfill created_at (e.g., from ObjectId timestamp) — otherwise period reports systematically under-count historical cash_out.

Persisted sales/purchases/production created_at is stored as ISO string; the range query uses string $gte/$lt comparison which works only because ISO-8601 sorts lexicographically. Fine, but worth a comment; if tz-aware strings ever mix with naive strings, comparisons will silently misbehave.
GET /api/reports has no upper bound on to_list(2000) — for high-volume months this silently truncates aggregates. Aggregate on the DB side ($group) instead of pulling docs.
No validation on `period` format itself: period='abcd-99' returns 500/crash (int() ValueError bubbles as unhandled). Add regex validation and return 422 with a clear message.
seed_data_creation: None. Tests create TEST_ prefixed purchases/production and Shopee sales on existing LIN-OVR-001 stock. All new tests are robust against pytest-xdist parallel execution (use >= for shared counters, avoid extra stock consumption in the period-filter test).
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py now contains 23 tests including TestReportsPeriodFilter (10 tests) covering all period filter scenarios from iteration_4 spec. Uses -n 2 --dist loadscope via /app/backend/pytest.ini. Legacy purchases/production docs without created_at are excluded from period-scoped reports — this is expected behavior after the created_at addition. Frontend was NOT tested (backend-only scope).
rca of the issue: N/A - no bugs found in the requested scope. All period filter, previous-period comparison, delta computation, year-rollover/rollforward, validation (422), and channel+period combination scenarios behave per spec.
